items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: I would love to play the trumpet in the way Michael Brecker played the tenor or Oscar Peterson played the piano. That’s my goal, my heroes

ctx.x: Oh absolutely. It’s a two way, it’s a two way thing of course. Your element — one thing — and the other one, you know, you have to, in the end, it’s a way to create your speech

you know. And the way to gather your ideas that makes sense. I have some melodic — some people for example, they believe when you’re playing fast you are throwing notes. That’s a stupid mistake. We don’t throw in notes. For something, and the way we learn solfeggio, we name it, every name of the notes. We don’t say do-re-me da-ba-da — no no. We say do-re-mi-fa-sol-la-ti-do [continues to scat quickly]. When I’m playing fast, very fast, some people criticize, yeah okay. And I always, my response to that is I would…
